description: Two ESP32 GPIO-driven LED channels: J_IN1 signal through R1 (330 Ω) to the red LED D1, and J_IN2 signal through R2 (330 Ω) to the green LED D2, with both cathodes on a GND shared with J_POWER.
assumptions: The NodeMCU ESP32 is not in the kit and cannot be placed by the robot, so it stays off the board and is connected with hand-wired jumpers.
J_IN1 and J_IN2 are connection points for two ESP32 GPIO outputs (3.3 V logic). Their negative pins are tied to the shared GND.

J_POWER is the connection point for the ESP's 3V3/GND supply. Its negative pin is on the shared GND. Its positive pin (3V3) connects to nothing on the board and is only a hand-wiring point for the ESP's 3V3 pin.
Supply is a regulated 3.3 V, or the ESP is powered over USB. Never feed 5 V into the ESP's 3V3 pin.
Uses both 330 Ω parts in the kit: resistor_330ohm_gap_1 for R1 and resistor_330ohm_gap_0 for R2. That gives roughly 3–4 mA per LED at 3.3 V.
Each LED's anode faces its resistor and GPIO (higher potential), and its cathode goes to GND. The LED is on when the GPIO is driven HIGH.
The e-ink screen is not part of this circuit.
